description: Security-review the GitHub Actions workflows in this project that run coding agents (claude-code-action, run-gemini-cli, codex, opencode, aider…): triggers outside contributors control (pull_request_target, issue_comment, issues) combined with secrets, issue/PR text interpolated into prompts or shells (prompt injection), unrestricted agent tools, broad permissions, unpinned agent actions. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

files.description: Workflow files to review instead of .github/workflows/*.yml

name: codexguild_scan_workflows
